spec.behavior: Maintain a JSON task store in tasks.json. Add assigns the next integer id and persists; done marks an existing task done or reports a missing id; list prints tasks in id order and open/done totals.

jet.author: luna-max

E0002: this `{` never gets a matching `}`
E0001: `\r` isn't an escape Jet knows

jet.notes: Raw process.argv dispatch because typed subcommands were not used. #Codable on a user struct hit an AOT ICE (generated Rust E0308), so the final version uses dynamic DataTree parsing and manual JSON writing. Default jet run with forwarded args produced blank stdout because process.argv saw only [jet]; profile=debug AOT produced the canonical six-step output.
